version_strings.where: decrypted image 96B version block @0x40 (image offset 0x40, after 64B uImage header)

notes: SHRS-encrypted firmware (magic 'SHRS', fixed IV 67c6697351ff4aec29cdbaabf2fbe346); binwalk on raw .bin yields only one false positive (MySQL ISAM @0x2C3F4E) — expected for this format.

Decrypt chain: dd skip=1756 | openssl aes-128-cbc -d -nopad -nosalt -K C05FBF1936C99429CE2A0781F08D6AD8 (key reused across D-Link 2020-era models, e.g. DIR-3060/DIR-882); 'bad decrypt' final-block warning is benign (trailing bytes past padded length).
Decrypted = 64B uImage header + 96B version block + LZMA(props 0x5D) -> vmlinux 23333312 B (kernel 3.10.14, Realtek SDK).
Rootfs is kernel-embedded initramfs, NOT squashfs: embedded LZMA (usize=-1) at vmlinux@0x858EA8 -> 70163456 B cpio(newc) -> extracted to rootfs/ (1627 files + 263 symlinks).

Web stack: lighttpd + FastCGI; web roots at rootfs/etc_ro/web and rootfs/etc_ro/lighttpd/www; HNAP handler binary present at rootfs/bin/prog-cgi (MIPS32 rel2 LSB, stripped, 1032612 B) — relevant anchor for CVE-2022-31414 (prog.cgi).
No literal '1.11B03'/'111b03'/'20200516' string inside rootfs etc/ or web roots (grep -rIa): firmware version is carried in the image header version block; runtime version likely from NVRAM default.
etc/sdk.version=1443366e (SDK build id) and etc_ro/mydlink/version=3.0.0-b89 (mydlink agent) are component versions, not firmware version — not contradictions.
Additional ELFs confirming arch: bin/prog-cgi, usr/sbin/pppoe-discovery, usr/sbin/dhcp6ctl, usr/sbin/mosquitto (all MIPS32 rel2 LSB, /lib/ld-uClibc.so.0).
